verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented replay or backfill feature for sending archived events to a new destination or re-sending history after a pipeline failure. What it does show is adjacent only: Hightouch Events stores collected events in the customer's warehouse, and syncs use CDC to send only new, changed and removed rows. Neither is a documented replay capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
